text:
sara: Quick PSA — pushed RBAC refactor to staging; renamed role `viewer` -> `read-only` to align with policy names. Tests green but support reported some service-account calls getting 403s :eyes:
ben: Seeing 403s in app logs for system service accounts — stack traces point to the SDK perm resolver still checking for `viewer`. Example call: `redwood.rbac.has_role(sa_id, 'viewer')`
marta: Confirmed in audit: entries show `role_mismatch` for sa-1234 and sa-5678 after the refactor. Backend mapping changed but some consumers weren't updated.
oliver: Triaging steps that helped me: 1) `rbac-inspect --id sa-1234` 2) look at `/etc/redwood/rbac/mappings.yaml` 3) query audit index for `role_change` events. Also check KMS bindings if decrypt calls fail.
ben: I can ship an SDK fallback quick-win — check both `viewer` and `read-only` during role checks, then log a deprecation warning. Will prepare 0.8.7 with unit tests.
diana: Long-term we should migrate stored principals to canonical role names and emit an audit migration event. Docs and changelog need to reflect this.
sara: Plan: hotfix the SDK + add a gateway shim to normalize role names at the edge. If that stabilizes canary, schedule full deploy. Ben, tag me on the PR and ping infra for a 30m deploy window.
sec-bot: Incident created: RBAC-2026-03-18 — 403s for service accounts after role rename. Severity: low-medium. Ticket RBAC-2026-03-18.
ben: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/rdw-sdk/pull/289 — fallback check + tests. @deploy-bot start canary for staging.
deploy-bot: Canary started: staging -> canary nodes. Smoke tests passed after SDK fallback enabled; no new 403s in canary logs.
marta: Note: KMS policies also referenced role name strings — found a handful of KMS denies (`kms:decrypt`) tied to `viewer`. Opening KMS ticket KMS-457 so infra can update key policies and document migration steps.
oliver: I'll update internal RBAC guide with a migration CLI snippet and example audit queries. Doc link (WIP): https://internal.docs/redwood/rbac-migration
diana: Support playbook to add: 1) run `rbac-inspect` 2) if alias present run `rbac-migrate --alias` 3) escalate to infra for KMS policy updates. Add sample commands and expected audit entries.
sara: Timeline — SDK patch in canary at 17:42 UTC, monitor for 30m. If stable, full rollout in 30m after that. Postmortem only if any customer impact or if issue reaches prod.
ben: :thumbsup: Will add release note, changelog entry, and a short paragraph in release email to customers who use service accounts.
thread_text_summary: RBAC role rename caused service-account 403s; temporary SDK fallback, gateway shim, KMS policy ticket, docs and support playbook updates planned; canary deployed and monitoring.
